items.title: Widerspruch gegen Bescheid (Arbeitsunfall-Anerkennung)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted 20.11.2026 (Friday) by a social-law body (Unfallkasse, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). Delivery fiction: 4th day after posting, counting calendar days and not counting the posting day itself: Day1=21.11 (Sat), Day2=22.11 (Sun), Day3=23.11 (Mon), Day4=24.11.2026 (Tue). Social-law bodies do not shift the delivery day even if it falls on a weekend/holiday (unlike tax offices) — but 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday anyway, so delivery = 24.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / SGB X) runs from that delivery day (day of event not counted) to the day with the same number next month: 24.12.2026. 24 December is a statutory working day in NW (not a public holiday) and is a Thursday, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed. Final day: 24.12.2026.
